instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: When there is room, I like things presented in front of my left shoulder. Use the accessible side when a shelf blocks the other side.
context.observed_robot_action: Present it in the person's right-front quarter.

motion_options.A: Point to your left-front quarter for the drink.
motion_options.B: Point to your right-front quarter for the drink.
